description_en: Deletes a custom domain name from a Software as a Service (SaaS) site based on its HostnameId
description_zh: 根据 HostnameId，删除站点下的单条 SaaS 域名
name: DeleteCustomHostname

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom hostname. To obtain this ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html operation
parameters.help_zh: SaaS 域名的 ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3018667.html接口获取
parameters.name: hostname_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
